notes.title: Levaluhta
notes.notes:
[b]Levaluhta [/b]is a narrative-driven 2D horror-survival/adventure game based on the book by the same name. The story revolves around an ancient burial site in Orismala, a struggling eldercare nurse, and a lonely old woman.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28704884/2ddb3c5d9ed98a946039c65cbc1c755916388419.png[/img]

With gameplay-driven storytelling and slow-paced claustrophobic dread, Leväluhta is a unique horror
experience like no other. The game is aimed to mature audience: No jumpscares nor buckets of blood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28704884/c2f78585e27ce39ed7114cd25c80771e61872167.png[/img]

[h1]Wishlist now:[/h1] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1481760/Levaluhta/]Levaluhta on Steam[/url]

notes.title: Good Mourning Early Access now available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28704884/5f6e814070d26a89bc338661c8a1d4b508642eb4.png[/img]

[h3]World’s first run-based walking simulator available now available on Steam Early Access![/h3]

Good Mourning is a narrative experiment, where the content is chosen at random for each playthrough, and the gameplay builds upon itself. Good Mourning is the world’s first run-based walking simulator.
Released on Steam’s Early Access October 23rd, Good Mourning introduces a game, where the story is randomly created by combining the contents of dozens of levels for a single playthrough. During the EA phase, this content is expanded to produce a game where every playthrough is different from one another.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1338790/Good_Mourning/

[h3]Good Mourning revolves around everyday life[/h3]

The story elements of Good Mourning revolve around everyday life, where choices and consequences play an important role. The content is presented through a filter of fantasy, which is further emphasized by the minimalistic and surreal audiovisuals. The narrative introduces the ups and downs of ordinary life, but it doesn’t shy away from serious and uncomfortable themes. 

Following in the footsteps of award-winning Lydia, Good Mourning is a fast-paced narrative experience, which can be played over and over again, with different results.

And there's also really nice bundle available containing Lydia and Good Mourning:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16453/Platonic_Bundle/

[previewyoutube=UBzpcGgDDcI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Lydia won big time at Finnish Game Awards 2018
notes.notes:
[b]Platonic Partnership won [i]The Best Creative Achievement of the Year[/i] and 
[i]People’s Choice Game of the Year[/i] -awards with their debut Lydia.[/b]

From Neogames Finland Association's website:

[i]"From Lydia has received a lot of fame and glory in various arenas. A tiny new studio’s first game, Lydia is a promising and carefully thought-out entity whose implementation is harmonious and where all elements fit seamlessly together. Lydia has a message that it carries beautifully and deliberately. 

The gaming magazine Pelit gave away their traditional “Kyöpeli” trophy to the People’s Choice Game of the Year 2017. The winner this year was Lydia by Platonic Partnership."[/i] 

More info: [url=http://www.neogames.fi/fga18winners/]Neogames.fi[/url]

notes.title: Thanks for the amazing user reviews!
notes.notes:
We’ve gotten some pretty amazing coverage from the games media, but we haven’t properly thanked you guys for the awesome user reviews you’ve written about Lydia. We are absolutely stunned by the positive feedback you’ve given us. 

Here are some selected quotes from the reviews: 

“I laughed and I cried, became one of my favourite games instantly.” 

“I'ts amazing that a small team can release such an atmospheric title.” 

“One of the most memorable game experiences I've had” 

“This game left me speechless and touched, even though the game was pretty short.” 

“Lydia dares to approach a subject that has until now been avoided in video games.” 

“Having experienced alcoholism or similar illness of a relative or a friend makes this game a heart-wrenching and personal experience unlike many others.” 

“I was seeking a short psychological horror game that would emotionally wreck me, and this hit the spot. ” 

“Dark, sad, touching and made me think. This is art.” 

“Dark, beautiful, so upsetting. Very short but worth every dollar. Now, please excuse me while i go hug my child.” 

“A touching and stylish game, easily worth the money.” 

“I have played some games with this premise before, but this one is probably the scariest one that I have seen, and it impacted me more than any other.” 

“Interesting piece of social engineering – I dare you to play this one and not feel emotions.” 

“Just buy this game and complete it! You'll not regret it!”

notes.title: New update with fixed game start language out soon!
notes.notes:
We are currently working with an update which will fix some minor grammar and other details in new supported languages. We will also crush the bug that makes the game start with Russian language by default for some players. 

If the game starts in Russian and you want to change the language, just click the third option counting from the top on main menu. And then click the last option on the bottom. That should change the language. 

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Raving reviews sale!
notes.notes:
[b]Critically acclaimed Lydia available with 33 per cent discount for a limited time![/b]

We’ve gotten some gosh darn positive reviews within a few days, and as a thank you, we’re cutting the price of ‘Lydia’ for a limited time. We can now tick one of three boxes (Critically acclaimed) off our list. Next up Best-selling and Award-winning.

[i]Adventure Gamers[/i]: This surreal, hard-hitting interactive story about childhood trauma is light on gameplay but as emotionally dark as you can probably bear.

[i]Pelit Magazine[/i]: Lydia is a grim tale of alcohol and abuse. The story-driven adventure is a small indie gem.

[i]Pelaaja Magazine[/i]: Only a handful of games are important works of art on their own merit or a force, that matures the gaming culture as a whole. Lydia achieves both of these goals.

Oh, and if you’re not an native English speaker, you might want to check out the Options menu… ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Lydia - Steam Update v1.02
notes.notes:
Lydia - Steam Update v1.02 Patch Notes

-    Implemented a new save system. Progress is saved automatically in start of each scene. Previously saved games are discarded
-    Implemented new options menu. Resolution and full screen selections are now moved to options menu. The Unity start dialog is now disabled
-    Added a speech volume slider in options menu
-    Implemented a tutorial for Quick Time Event, that takes place on the first chapter of the game
-    Updated main menu
-    Added splash screens to menu (New game overwrite warning, quit game warning & information about autosave when player clicks the new game button)
-    Fixed layer bugs in various scenes
-    Fixed minor audio issues throughout the game
-    Fixed minor graphical issues throughout the game

notes.title: Lydia releases June 2nd
notes.notes:
Lydia is now complete. Only thing to do is to polish the game, and make sure that you guys get the best possible experience. 

The game launches next Friday, and we are thrilled. As this is our first commercial title, we're really looking forward for your feedback and comments. 

[i]We would appreciate very much if those of you buying the game would also be kind enough to post a review.[/i]

Thank you for your support so far, and hopefully you will enjoy playing the game as much as we have enjoyed developing it. 

[b]This game is for you.[/b]
